## Problem

What you are trying to accomplish, and what makes it hard today. Describe the
problem before the solution.

## Proposal

What you think Pharos should do.

## Scope

- [ ] I have read `PLAN.md` and this is not already covered
- [ ] This does not require Pharos to know about a specific backend product
- [ ] This does not require executing arbitrary code received over the network

The third box is not a formality. Pharos renders content and runs a fixed
command allowlist; anything that needs a general-purpose execution surface
belongs in the system driving Pharos, not in Pharos.

## Non-scope

What this deliberately does not include.

## How it would be verified

What a reviewer would run or look at to agree it works — including, for anything
on screen, how it behaves with a D-pad.
